name: phonon-webgpu
description: Phonon 31M text-to-speech on WebGPU, with the time of every word.

scripts.build: rm -f dist/cpu/remote-*.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=dist --entry-names=phonon --chunk-names=cpu/[name]-[hash] && esbuild src/cpu-worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --define:__PROFILE__=false --outfile=dist/cpu/phonon-cpu.js && npm run site && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.site: rm -f docs/cpu/remote-*.js && esbuild site/site.ts --bundle --splitting --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outdir=docs --entry-names=site --chunk-names=cpu/[name]-[hash] && esbuild src/cpu-worker.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --define:__PROFILE__=false --minify --outfile=docs/cpu/phonon-cpu.js && cp dist/cpu/phonon-cpu-relaxed.wasm dist/cpu/phonon-cpu-simd.wasm docs/cpu/ && cp site/coi.js docs/ && esbuild scripts/build-site.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=.test/build-site.mjs --log-level=warning && node .test/build-site.mjs
